title: Swiss-Judgment-Prediction: A Multilingual Legal Judgment Prediction Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model prediction performance (F1-scores) across cases originating from different regional jurisdictions (Swiss cantons).
Evaluating and comparing model predictive performance across different categories of law (e.g., penal, public, social, and civil law).
Analyzing legal judgment prediction performance fluctuations across different case publication years (diachronicity) to test for robustness over time.
Comparing the performance of monolingual and multilingual language models on subsets of data written in different languages (German, French, and Italian).
